title: ShieldCare Excess: the Reduction for a Prompt Report
content:
The excess on an approved claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is reduced where the loss
was reported promptly, read from the days between the day the loss happened and the day it was
reported.

| How promptly the loss was reported | The reduction for a prompt report |
| --- | --- |
| reported inside 3 days of it happening | 50.00 |
| reported more than 3 days but no more than 7 days after it happened | 22.50 |
| every other claim | no reduction for a prompt report is allowed |

### Both sides of the two windows

A report made on the day of the loss, or up to and including 3 days after it, carries the reduction of
50.00. A report made 4 days after the loss is more than 3 days after it and carries 22.50, as does a
report made exactly 7 days after it. A report made on the 8th day carries no reduction at all.

### Cases on hypothetical dates

| Days between the loss and the report | Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 30 | none |
| 8 | none |
| 7 | 22.50 |
| 4 | 22.50 |
| 3 | 50.00 |
| 0 | 50.00 |
